name: Holy Week
overview: Holy Week centers on the profound love and purpose of Christ as He approaches the fulfillment of His mission to depart from this world to the Father, demonstrated by His love for His own until the end (John 13:1). It begins with the dawning of the first day of the week when Mary Magdalene and the other Mary visit the empty tomb, signaling Christ's resurrection and victory over death (Matthew 28:1). Jesus is revealed as the true Light who enlightens every person entering the world (John 1:9), offering comfort and assurance to believers to trust in Him and not be troubled (John 14:1). Moreover, He promises that whatever is asked in His name will be done, emphasizing the power and authority given to His followers (John 14:14). This week encapsulates the divine plan by which God, who created all things by His word and breath (Psalms 33:6), brings salvation through Christ's sacrificial love.
